String reference =
            "cfg-"
                + UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(
                    (id + ":secret:" + name + ":fill.value").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        ObjectNode config =
            configs
                .addObject()
                .put("referenceId", reference)
                .put("stepId", id)
                .put("referenceName", name)
                .put("kind", "secretRef")
                .put("intendedSlot", "fill.value");
        privateConfigs.set(reference, config.deepCopy());
      }

independence: Java local uses ordinary STEP_ID and literal PASS/fill.value; no classifier invocation or manifest/action/summary/row read in expected-value calculation.
